entries.title: Ask HN: Our AWS account got compromised after their outage
entries.author: kinj28
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Our AWS account got compromised after their outage
entries.excerpt: Could there be any link between the two events? Here is what happened: Some 600 instances were spawned within 3 hours before AWS flagged it off and sent us a health event. There were numerous domains verified and we could see SES quota increase request was made. We are still investigating the vulnerability at our end. our initial suspect list has 2 suspects. api key or console access where MFA wasn’t enabled.
entries.guide_zh: AWS 故障后账号出现数百个陌生实例，发帖者询问账号入侵是否与故障有关。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who uses open LLMs and coding assistants locally? Share setup and laptop
entries.author: threeturn
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Who uses open LLMs and coding assistants locally? Share setup and laptop
entries.excerpt: Dear Hackers, I’m interested in your real-world workflows for using open-source LLMs and open-source coding assistants on your laptop (not just cloud/enterprise SaaS). Specifically: Which model(s) are you running (e.g., Ollama, LM Studio, or others) and which open-source coding assistant/integration (for example, a VS Code plugin) you’re using? What laptop hardware do you have (CPU, GPU/NPU, memory, whether discrete GPU or integrated, OS) and how it performs for your workflow
entries.guide_zh: 谁在本地使用开放模型和编程助手，邀请分享电脑配置与真实工作流程。

entries.title: Ask HN: How to stop an AWS bot sending 2B requests/month?
entries.author: lgats
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to stop an AWS bot sending 2B requests/month?
entries.excerpt: I have been struggling with a bot– 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; crawler)' coming from AWS Singapore – and sending an absurd number of requests to a domain of mine, averaging over 700 requests/second for several months now. Thankfully, CloudFlare is able to handle the traffic with a simple WAF rule and 444 response to reduce the outbound traffic. I've submitted several complaints to AWS to get this traffic to stop, their typical followup is: We have engaged with our customer, and
entries.guide_zh: 来自 AWS 的爬虫每月发送二十亿次请求，怎样有效阻断这种访问？

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (October 2025)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please state the location and include REMOTE for remote work, REMOTE (US) or similar if the country is restricted, and ONSITE when remote work is not an option. Please only post if you personally are part of the hiring company—no recruiting firms or job boards. One post per company. If it isn't a household name, explain what your company does. Please only post if you are actively filling a position and are committed to responding to applicants. Commenters: please don't reply
entries.guide_zh: 2025 年 10 月招聘集中帖，查看企业需求与远程工作的地区条件。
